pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa bhikkhunūpassayaṃ nissāya yavakhettaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.3: bhikkhuniyo uccāram pi passāvam pi saṃkāram pi vighāsam pi khette chaḍḍenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ yavakhettaṃ dūsessantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa brāhmaṇassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā tā ujjhāyanti --pa--: kathaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.8: hi nāma bhikkhuniyo uccāram pi . . . vighāsam pi harite chaḍḍessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā saṃkāraṃ vā vighāsaṃ vā harite chaḍḍeyya vā chaḍḍāpeyya vā, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.14: pubbaṇṇaṃ aparaṇṇaṃ yaṃ manussānaṃ upabhogaparibhogaṃ ropimaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.1: harite haritasaññā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā, āpatti pācittiyassa.
